Question: I'm still getting spam calls despite registering for DND — what can I do?

Answer: Report the offending number via Help > Report UCC (Unsolicited Commercial Communication) with the date/time of the call. Repeated complaints against a number are escalated to TRAI's complaint-monitoring system.

Topic: DND & Spam Management
title: I'm still getting spam calls despite registering for DND — what can I do?
